name: io.github.usezn/zn-gate
description: Local security layer for coding agents: prompt-injection checks, secret redaction, MCP proxy.

environmentVariables.name: ZN_LOCAL_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to force local-only mode, even if ZN_CLOUD=1.

environmentVariables.name: ZN_CLOUD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let prompt analysis also query the optional cloud classifier. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: ZN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the optional cloud check. Has no effect without ZN_CLOUD=1.
